function_v0.doc:
Execute one swap leg through the wrapped Aquarius pool. Router-only.

Precondition: the caller (Batching Router) has already transferred
`amount_in` of `token_in` to this adapter. The resulting `token_out` is
sent to `recipient`. `min_out` is a per-leg floor (the Batching Router
passes 0 and enforces the overall minimum itself). `data` is the
32-byte Aquarius `pool_index` selecting one pool of the pair's set.
